content.text: NATURALLY TRUE TO THE Orange AND Blue Welcome to the official website of the campus-voted mascot for the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign: THE BELTED KINGFISHER WHY THE KINGFISHER? The University of Illinois deserves a mascot as fierce and vibrant as our students, alumni, and community members.As a year-round resident of Champaign parks, ponds, and rivers, the Belted Kingfisher would serve as a unique mascot future generations of Illinois alumni can proudly call their own. OUR STORY Students Clamor for New Mascot2011: 85% of respondents in a campus-wide survey vote in favor of a mascot change Unique Proposal Takes Flight!2019: Spencer Hulsey proposes the Belted Kingfisher as a mascot Students Vote YES!2020: Majority of students voted to adopt the Belted Kingfisher as a mascot in the Spring referendum Faculty too!2020: The U of I Faculty Senate voted 105 – 2 to adopt the Belted Kingfisher as the university’s official mascot Spanning Across Generations2020: The Illinois Alumni for the Kingfisher proves cross-generational appeal Our King Arrives2023: The King’s Guard begins their on-campus presence with a physical mascot costume It’s a Three-peat!2025: Majority of students reaffirm that we want a mascot in the Spring referendum R-S-Oh Yeah!2025: The King’s Guard becomes an official Registered Student Organization 0+Campus event appearances 0+RSO / Dept. logo features WHY A MASCOT? Mascots are more than just a courtside character.Mascots serve as a unifying symbol of school spirit and create enduring bonds between students and members of our community. Our University’s near two-decade gap without a mascot has impeded developing these shared traditions.The Kingfisher’s goal is to enhance (not replace) existing traditions and develop new ones in a way that is accessible and enjoyable for everyone!
